# Keenpix v0.3.3

## Highlights

- All public @keenpix packages install with npm, pnpm and yarn again; the 0.3.2 tarballs contained unresolved workspace dependencies.
- This release also carries the fixes merged since v0.3.2.

## Platform

The five platform apps share version 0.3.3 and include the fixes merged since v0.3.2.

## Public packages

### `@keenpix/core`

All public packages are packed with resolved dependency ranges. Every packed manifest and built distribution is checked before publication begins.

### `@keenpix/next`

The dependency on core resolves to the 0.3.3 release range.

### `@keenpix/nuxt`

Dependencies on core and Vue resolve to the 0.3.3 release range.

## Published components

{{version_matrix}}

## Upgrade notes

- Upgrade public packages to 0.3.3. Existing 0.3.2 tarballs cannot be repaired in place.
- Runtime image publication and deployment remain separate manual steps.
- No API or peer dependency range changes are required for this packaging fix.
